data.text: **Red-Green-Refactor** is the core TDD cycle: write a failing test (Red), make it pass with minimal code (Green), then improve the code (Refactor).

items: Red – Write a test that fails
Green – Write minimal code to pass
Refactor – Improve code while keeping tests green

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Write only enough code to pass
data.takeaway: Follow Red-Green-Refactor for incremental, tested development.
